metadata.source: User-provided Patwari sketch map ("Map of Tehsil Nishtar District Lahore"), georeferenced against mouzas_nishtar.geojson
metadata.method: Read approximate pixel positions of 26 mouza labels shared with mouzas_nishtar.geojson off the sketch, fit a least-squares affine transform (sketch pixel -> WGS84 lon/lat) from those 26 control points, then applied it to the sketch positions of the 10 Patwari mouzas absent from every PULSE data source.
metadata.accuracy: Approximate only. RMS residual on the 26 control points was ~835m (max ~2.2km) out of a tehsil roughly 24km across -- good enough to say which neighbourhood a mouza is in, not to draw its boundary.

properties.note: No PULSE boundary exists for this mouza (checked exhaustively -- see mouzas_nishtar_reconciliation.md). This point is an ESTIMATED centroid only, not a survey position: derived by georeferencing a hand-drawn Patwari sketch map against the 26 neighbouring mouzas that ARE in PULSE, via a least-squares affine fit (RMS residual ~835m, worst case ~2.2km on the known mouzas). Treat as "roughly here", not a boundary or an exact point.
